note: Weekly (ISO week, UTC) aggregate counts only. No IP addresses, user agents, cookies, keys or per-caller data. ref is the ?ref= channel tag. Refs ci, qa, test, smoke, house-* and t<N>/t<N>-* are our own checks and are excluded from external_mcp_tool_calls. Calls with no ref are counted separately in untagged_mcp_tool_calls and may include our own checks. feed_fetches_by_ref counts only feed fetches through the hosted worker, not GitHub Pages feed hits. mcp_initialize_by_ref['mcp-registry'] is probably MCP Registry health checks, not users.

sources.feed_fetches: hosted worker only (lantern-works-mcp.lantern-works.workers.dev/api/...); GitHub Pages feed hits are not counted
sources.mcp_initialize_mcp_registry: probably MCP Registry health checks, not users
sources.outbound_clicks: T135 agreed click count: server-side /go/<deal-id> redirects (telemetry worker D1, aggregate day x deal x provider x src x ref x ua_class; no IPs, user agents or cookies), minus known bots, crawlers, link previews, HTTP scripts and prefetches (ua_class bot|script|prefetch) and minus our own test traffic (src *-test or internal ref). Per week in clicks {count, by_provider, by_source, excluded, unclassified_ua}.
sources.clicks_reconciliation: T135: before Nov 11 2026, outbound_clicks was the Web Analytics beacon's /e/out/ count, which only fires from site JavaScript, while go_clicks counted every server-side /go/ redirect (mostly src=feed). The week of Nov 2 (2026-W45) had 19 /go/ redirects (all src=feed, no ref, 17 providers, Nov 6-7 UTC) and 0 beacon events, so the two never measured the same thing. outbound_clicks now equals clicks.count; the beacon figure is kept as beacon_out_events. Clicks recorded before the UA filter shipped have no UA class and are counted but reported in clicks.unclassified_ua, not dropped or relabelled.
sources.page_views: null: not queried in this run: CI has no Cloudflare token; page views are filled box-side through the Cloudflare connector (scripts/rum_box_fill.py)
sources.visits_by_ref: null: not queried in this run: CI has no Cloudflare token; page views are filled box-side through the Cloudflare connector (scripts/rum_box_fill.py)
sources.installs_by_ref: null: not measurable: the opt-in telemetry worker records day x tool x version only, with no install id or ref; an install id needs the owner's approval. Hosted connects by ref are in mcp_initialize_by_ref.
sources.receipts_funnel: T55: Receipts (MCP test summaries) measured apart from GPU demand. page_views = beacon views of /receipts/ pages; visits_by_ref / mcp_initialize_by_ref / mcp_tool_calls_by_ref = refs matching receipts or receipts-<channel> only. api/v1/receipts.json is served by GitHub Pages, which publishes no fetch counts, so json_fetches is null. Independent inquiries arrive by email and are not published here (null).
sources.go_clicks: telemetry worker /go/<deal-id>?src= redirect (aggregate day x deal x provider x src x ref x ua_class in D1; no IPs, user agents or cookies). go_clicks_by_provider = clicks.count split by provider and src. test_go_clicks_by_provider = our own test clicks (src *-test or internal ref)
sources.agent_query_to_click: T136: agent_query_to_click = agent_mcp_clicks / agent_tool_calls per ISO week. agent_tool_calls = hosted worker tool calls (hits kind=tool) minus house traffic (src_class house, or a house ref: ci, qa, test, smoke, house-*, t<N>) and known bots. agent_mcp_clicks = clicks.by_source.mcp (the src=mcp /go/ links in MCP results), already without bots and house clicks. Clicks also come from local (stdio) installs, whose calls the hosted worker cannot see, so the rate can overstate hosted-only conversion. null when no agent calls.
sources.demand_daily: P8: daily aggregate demand from hosted GPU tool calls (compare_gpu_prices, estimate_job_cost, optimize_agent_stack): one count per UTC day x tool x gpu_family x region_group x price_tier x cheapest_provider. gpu_family is the requested GPU bucketed to a fixed list of known families (anything else 'other', none 'any'); region_group is the requested region bucketed likewise; price_tier and cheapest_provider describe the first-ranked result in our answer ('none' when there was none). No caller IDs, raw arguments or free text are stored. House traffic and known bots are not counted. Hosted endpoint only; local (stdio) installs are not included.
